meta.title: Wyndham Royal Beachfront Resort & Villas Hoi An Vietnam | Full Resort Tour 2026
meta.description:
📍 Wyndham Royal Beachfront Resort & Villas | Hoi An, Vietnam
Wyndham Royal Beachfront Resort & Villas Hoi An Vietnam Full Resort Tour 2026

Thinking about booking Wyndham Royal Beachfront Resort & Villas in Hoi An, Vietnam? In this video, I take you on a complete walking tour of the entire resort so you can see exactly what to expect before reserving your stay.

From the grand lobby and restaurants to the pools, fitness center, gardens, beachfront villas, family amenities, and private beach, this tour covers every corner of the property. I also share a look at the hotel accommodations versus the residential villa area, making it easier to decide which option is right for your trip.

Located along Vietnam's beautiful central coast between Hoi An and Da Nang, Wyndham Royal Beachfront Resort & Villas is a popular choice for families, couples, long-term travelers, and anyone looking for a luxury beachfront resort with direct beach access and plenty of on-site amenities.

During this tour you'll see:
• Resort entrance and lobby
• Gift shops and lounge areas
• Restaurants and dining options
• Main swimming pool and kids pool
• Fitness center
• Gardens and animal area
• Beach access and shoreline
• Hotel accommodations
• Residential villa community
• Oceanfront pool and bar
• Beachfront restaurant
• Playground and family amenities
• Recreational activities and rentals
• Beautiful green spaces throughout the resort

If you're researching where to stay in Hoi An, looking for the best beach resorts near Da Nang, or wondering if Wyndham Royal Beachfront Resort & Villas is worth booking, I hope this video helps you plan your trip.

comments.author: @MacheretOV
comments.text: Мы посещали данный Резорт 10 июня. Погода была приятной, без особой жары. Море спокойное, купались с наслаждением. Брали завтраки и ужин. Питание выше всяких похвал, разнообразное. На ужин предлагали много морепродуктов на гриле. За ужином была живая музыка. Детям на побережье после 17-00 устраивали пенную вечеринку. Это вызывало восторг у детей. Номера чистые и комфортные. Спасибо за прекрасные дни проведенные в отеле.
